_about: 1,4-Butanediol (1) + Tetrahydrofuran (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 50.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1,4-butanediol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: F. Sun, H. Du, C. Zhang, S. Ren, C. Yang, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for Binary System of Tetrahydrofuran + 1,4-Butanediol and gamma-Butyrolactone at 50.0 and 70.0 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 3872-3877
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.48 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
